claims.text: Existing LLMs do not have an inherent functionality to provide users with an uncertainty/confidence metric for generated responses.
Semantic density extracts uncertainty/confidence information for each response from a probability distribution perspective in semantic space.
Semantic density has no restriction on task types and is off-the-shelf for new models and tasks.
Semantic density demonstrates superior performance and robustness compared to prior uncertainty quantification approaches.

evidence.description: Experiments on seven state-of-the-art LLMs, including Llama 3 and Mixtral-8x22B, on four free-form question-answering benchmarks.

methodologies.name: Semantic Density
methodologies.description: Extracts uncertainty/confidence information for LLM responses from a probability distribution perspective in semantic space.

limitations.text: Prior uncertainty quantification methods are restricted to classification tasks, require additional training and data, consider only lexical information, and are prompt-wise rather than response-wise.
